test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'No'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** phrase in question indicates** the absence of any personal financial or legal consequences for the actions or "games" carried out by the bankers.
 
• The term** 'no'**, indicating a negative or absence of something, correctly fits the context of this sentence.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *'**Gaming in the banking sector seems virtually impossible to eliminate. The only effective measure to end it would be to make bankers personally liable for losses, to remove the sense that their actions - their games – have **no **personal financial or legal consequences. It is this, rather (4) ______ removing the cap on bankers' bonuses, that has the best chance of preventing the financial system blowing (5) ______ again.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Option 1',** 'never' **is incorrect as it indicates a time frame or frequency, which is not what is needed in this context.
 
• 'Option 2',** 'none'** is incorrect as it is not grammatically suitable for this sentence. 'None' is generally used for indicating no part of a whole, or no persons or things from a group.
 
• 'Option 3'**, 'not' **is incorrect as it is used to form the negative of verbs, whereas 'no' is used before a noun to indicate a complete absence of it, which is what is needed here.
